name: report_param
label: Report Template Parameter Table
description: Report template parameter table used for related queries related to report scenarios such as report queries.

fields.name: report_id
fields.description: Report ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Primary key. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the report_id, name fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the ID field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
